policy: Conservative union: P1 all-field reviews, P2 recent/sample description cohorts, P0 20-row source spot check and 28 industry source descriptions. Candidate lead dispositions alone do not qualify as whole-description review, even when a one_line was rewritten. They remain useful leads/evidence to reread. Institutional/code/family checks were only systematic in P1 key+industry rows; targeted individual metadata corrections are not counted as a full metadata audit. Counts concern catalog claims, not full-paper reading or replicated experiments.
selection: Current CSV order at base_commit; exclude prior whole-description union; first ceil(N/2) -> A and remainder -> B. No randomness or post-inspection changes.
